Loss report: gitea -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.matrix: across over the axes (the tasks run once per cell inside one across step; the outputs of the cells are not visible after it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
